chapter.verse: Tua mah bangin zite aw, na pasalte’ ukna uh na mang un. Tua ahih ciangin Pasian thu a ngai lo pasal kim khat a om uh leh, tuate in kihtakna tawh kipawl na gamtatna siangtho uh a muh uh ciangin, Pasian’ thu hang hi lo, amau zite gamtatna pha hangin amaute kingah ding uh hi.
Numeite kizepna pan samphekna, kham leh suangmanpha leh puansilhna ahi pualam kizemsak loin,
Pasian mai-ah a manpha, lungnemna lungsim, a kisia thei lo kizepna ahi, a kimu thei lo lungsim sung kizepna hi ta hen.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian lamenin a om numei siangthote in zong tang lai-in tua bangin a kizeem uh hi.
Sarah in Abraham, “topa,” ci-in a thu a man’ mah bangin, a pasalte’ ukna uh a mang uh hi. Note in zong a pha-in na gamtat uh a, launa na neih kei uh leh, Sarah’ tanute na suak ding uh hi.

Tua mah bangin pasalte aw, na thungetna uh nialna a om loh nadingin, nuntakna thupha hehpihna tawh kizomin a luahkhawm mite bangin, lungpilna leh thukhualna nei-in, na zite uh tawh omkhawmin, a hat lo zaw a panpih bangin kingaihsunin, na zite uh dawmin na hehpih un.
A tawpkhakna kam in, note khempeuh lungsim kikhatin om un, hehpihna lungsim nei un. Unau bangin na ki-it un, na kidahpih un, lungniamkhiatna na nei un.
Kitawng thuk kei un, kikosia kik kei un. Thupha na kipia un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note in thupha na luah nadingun hong sapsa mite na hi uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh: “Nuntakna-ah nuamsa a, ni hoih a nuam a mu nuam mi in, a leii in phatlohna a bawl loh nadingin kham hen. A muk in zuauthu a gen loh nadingin kham hen:
Gitlohna peelin, gitna bawl hen: Mi tawh kilem nading zongin, a phak dongin delh hen.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Topa’ mit in mi dikte a en hi, a bil in zong amau thungetna a ngai hi. Mawhna ahihte ahih uh leh, Topa in a nungngat hi.”
Note in thupha lamah lungsim a nei mi na hih uh leh, kua in note hong bawlsia ding hiam?
Thuman thutak hangin gimna na thuak uh leh, thupha na ngah ding uh hi. Amaute’ tawn’na na lau kei un, na lungmang kei un.

Na lungsim sung uhah Khazih in Topa ahi ci-in zahtakna nei un. Note’ lametna thu hong dong mi khempeuh kiangah lungnemna tawh, thusimna lungsim tawh na genkik theih nadingun, a kigingsa-in om tawntung un.
Khazih-ah note gamtat hoih uh a simmawhte in hong kosiat ciangin, note pumpi uh a maizum loh nadingun note lungsim kisuan’na om lo, siangtho-in na om un.
Pasian’ deihna a om leh, phatna na bawl manun na thuakna un, gitlohna na bawl man uh a, thuakna sangin a hoih zaw hi.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Khazih in a pum tawh sihna thuakin, kha tawh nuntakna ngah a, eite Pasian kiangah hong khak nadingin a mi dik mi in, mi diklote tangding mawhna hangin khat vei bek gimna a thuak hi.
Tua kha tawh Khazih pai a, thong sungah a kikhum khate kiangah thu a hilh hi.
Tua khate in nidang lai-inah Noah a khan’ lai-in tawmkhat ahi, mi giatte tui tawh a gup nading teembaw a bawl lai takun, Pasian in thuakin a ngak lai takin, thu a ngai lo khate ahi uh hi.

Tu-in baptaizna ahi tua tui in lim bangin, Zeisu Khazih’ thawhkikna hangin note hong gum hi. Tua note a hong gum baptaizna ka cih ciangin pumpi nin a kihhuaina sawp siang a cihnopna hi lo hi; lungsim kisuan’ lohna siangtho tawh Pasian mai-ah a mang ka cihnopna hi.
Tua Topa vantungah kahto a, Pasian’ ziat lamah a tu hi. Vantungmite akipan, a ukte leh vangliatnate in ama nuai-ah kikoihin a om hi.
